semantic.justification: Original ICU78.3 CalendarCache from astro.cpp, using the actual sized integer UHashtable. Native ccLock is projected to synchronous realm execution. Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module.
